Display Red Desire (Generic Formalwear_V-neck_Wine Red)
Performing dance steps

Let us imagine the melody as a minuet.
Match your rhythm together with mine.

Fufu, you are quite skilled.
Just like this, the two of us, like blossoms blooming in the hall—

(Ever since I met that person, this world...
seems to be taking on so much more color than before)
...Precisely because today was so wonderful—
Eh?

............!
—Yes. With pleasure.

Devoting yourself to bringing joy to others...
You truly are a noble person.

Apparently dancing is fine too, so long as it doesn't disturb other guests.
I drop to one knee before her bewildered gaze and extend a hand.

Huh? Whaaaat, really?!
—T-Trainer!
Eh?

Holding a grand ball in a place like this is a classic staple of isekai novels!
Someday I'd love to wear a gown and make my otherworld social debut...♪

Still—yes. Even if I were invited to a ball in "that land,"
I feel I could dance properly. Fufu... I think I've found some confidence.

Is there anything I can do for her sake?
As I ponder this while looking at the exhibition flyer—
One day off, while walking through the city—

Perhaps this depicts a village festival from back then.
I can almost hear the lilting music playing right now.

"May a drop of blessing grace these lives..."
Praying thus, I would gently smile in return.

Dancing like this in this world.
The sights I once wished for, taking shape piece by piece.

...I must change out of these clothes.
Come, shall we be on our way, Trainer?

Truly—... what a joyous thing it is.
To turn our thoughts together toward "that land," so very much so...

...Fufu, I can see it clearly. Minstrels singing in the plaza,
the clinking of wooden tankards in toasts all around—

Are you interested in dresses? If you'd like, as part of a special program,
you can try on costumes inspired by medieval nobility.

Yes. There is an art exhibition themed around medieval life.
I intend to let my thoughts dwell on life in "that land" there.

At this exhibition, in addition to costume rentals,
this hall was opened up for taking photos and videos.

(It is a delightful color............
............Yet the more colorful it becomes, deep inside my heart—)

And even now, at this very moment.
You set my heart dancing—...
...You are quite a wondrous person, Trainer.

Stepping to a quiet corner of the hall, we gently pace our steps together.
Before long, it felt as though elegant music began to drift into our ears...
Um, is it truly all right for us to dance here?

Hehe...
Actually wearing it makes me feel rather nervous.

—Oh, Trainer.
Are you out on a stroll?
Gracefully—and lightly—
The "shadows"... do cast quite deeply, don't they?
Ah... Is it closing time already?

Guided by the staff, Red Desire heads toward the dressing room with sheer delight.
Watching her, I found myself wishing she could enjoy herself even more.

Of course, I was devoting myself to my saintly training♪
I thought I would study up on "that land" in advance.

One... two, three.
Two, two, three.

—...It feels so wondrous.
It is as if the visions I once painted in my dreams are taking on vibrant color.
(Ding... Dong...)

"The museum will be closing shortly.
There are 30 minutes remaining until closing time."

Oh, my! This floor...!
Could it be modeled after a medieval castle?

—...How wonderful...!
It looks just like a ballroom straight out of an illustrated story...

The people of "that land" surely wore ornaments just like these...
...My, this painting! Look, Trainer.

Hehe, it seems I still have much more studying to do.
All for that destined day when I set foot upon "that land"—

To that distant otherworld... I shall not ask you to "come with me."
When that time comes, simply see me off with your heartfelt blessing.

Even on that day when we signed our contract.
You prepared such a wonderful stage for me.
(...The saint of a distant otherworld...)

"I am not anyone special."
You once said so before, but... I can state with certainty.

According to the story that granted me divine revelation in my childhood—
there is a high probability that medieval life closely mirrors that of "that land."

That bustling lively scene is a modest hymn to the journeys of everyday life—
As a saint, allow me to offer my prayers to this banquet.

Trainer, thank you for waiting.
Um, how does it look...?

Thank you so much for accompanying me today.
Thanks to you, I had a truly delightful time.

—Oh, I know!
If you would like, Trainer, would you join me?
(...The sunset is so beautiful.)
